skill.summary: Amazon Augmented AI Runtime API skill. Use when working with Amazon Augmented AI Runtime for human-loops. Covers 5 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Amazon Augmented AI Runtime API skill.

- Provides access to 5 endpoints for managing human-loops.
- Supports starting, stopping, listing, retrieving, and deleting human loops.
- Authentication via AWS SigV4.
- Requires the AMAZON_AUGMENTED_AI_RUNTIME_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes setup instructions and example CLI commands.
